title: LOCC Dense-Codeability of the Four-Qubit W State
exact_target: Can the four-qubit W state provide a dense-coding advantage when its two receivers communicate only classically?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000177 (OWR-785-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Entanglement and Decoherence: Mathematics and Physics of Quantum Information and Computation (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/04, pp. 185--255; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 19--21, printed pages 203--205.
Bruss et al., Dense coding with multipartite quantum states; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.
Yeo--Chua, teleportation and dense coding with genuine multipartite entanglement; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: This is the report's two-receiver LOCC question, not global decoding, a single-receiver protocol, or a teleportation question. Receiver partition and the report's encoding class remain part of the target.
